name: Vivea Gesundheitshotel Bad Häring
beschreibung: The Vivea Gesundheitshotel Bad Häring is located in Austrian Tyrol, nestled amidst the scenic mountain landscape of the Lower Inn Valley. Guests enjoy a health-conscious environment featuring programs focused on relaxation, physical exercise, and balanced nutrition. The hotel harmoniously pairs restorative recreation with preventive health therapies in a peaceful setting overlooking the Tyrolean peaks.
